setupDurations.notes: First bootstrap attempt failed with the sandbox Node v22.23.5 (Node 24+ required); rerun with /opt/node24 (v24.22.3). Reference built unpinned (--allow-unpinned-reference).

notes: Gate: sobel/prewitt/roberts integer sums are below 2^12, so a*a+b*b is exact fused or not, and power-of-two scales make sqrt*scale exact, so a fused multiply-add with any delta rounds like the unfused pair; those cases run everywhere. Scharr and non-power-of-two scales run only on linux-x64.

No macOS arm64 run was made from this branch; the gate is a precaution. In the sandbox, a double-precision kernel mutation and a fused (exact sqrt*scale+delta) mutation each failed only the linux-x64 API test, via step-5 ramp rounding-boundary cases with scale=0.7, while the portable tests passed.
The reference has --disable-x86asm, so ff_sobel_init_x86 is not used.
Registry support-matrix rows for the four operators are left to the coordinator, as the registry doc says.
